release_boundary: Public as a transformed composite: median, dispersion and source count only; per-source values never leave the internal layer.
labels: Per-source values are never published; median, dispersion and source count only

points.caliber_note: Mysteel value is the late-session range midpoint (back-derived from the next day's published change; derived value); SMM value is the daily average price
Dispersion mainly from timing caliber: SMM daily average fell 500 on the day while Mysteel late session rose 750 on after-hours futures strength (daily average vs late-session close)
SMM average is consistent with its range midpoint (89,800-93,800 -> 91,800)
SMM also has a parallel conflicting value of 91,200 via a Sina daily report (-620 basis); per discipline it is not adopted and not adjudicated, registered only in the internal input layer

Mysteel value is the early-session range midpoint (late session not yet published at collection time; substitution flagged); the three sources nearly coincide, consistent with the QC87-C survey cross-check
